stance: Labour market is low-hire, low-fire in the US: initial claims near 199k, 4-week average 198.5k, continuing claims flat at 1.71M. No turn: that needs rising claims, falling JOLTS openings and soft payrolls, and only claims is logged, not rising. UK: unemployment fell to 4.7% from 4.9% and regular pay held at 3.7%, while vacancies hit a 5-year low of 691k, so demand is cooling but slack is not building. UK payrolled change unconfirmed. Would change on US 4-week claims above 215k or continuing claims above 1.8M.
